clues.text: Elijah told Ahab to gather all Israel and the prophets of Baal to meet him on this mountain.
Elijah climbed to its summit, bent to the ground, and put his face between his knees while waiting for rain.
Nabal, a very wealthy man of Maon, was shearing his three thousand sheep in this place.
When David fled to Gath, his wife Abigail, the widow of Nabal, was named as being from here.
The Shunammite woman, grieving her son, rode a donkey to find Elisha at this mountain.
After two bears mauled the boys who mocked him near Bethel, Elisha went on to this mountain.
Samuel came to confront Saul and was told Saul had gone here and set up a monument for himself.
